## Service Modules & Deliverables

### 1. Personalized WebApps (CRM, ERP, Websites)
- What it replaces: Disconnected Google Sheets, slow off-the-shelf software, and high per-user monthly SaaS fees ($100–$250/user/mo).
- Tech Stack: React 19, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MySQL, TailwindCSS, Vite, Node.js.
- Key Deliverables:
  - Role-based access control (RBAC) with staff permissions.
  - Client issue and ticket tracking portals with passwordless token access.
  - Multi-tier ERP with inventory ledgers, purchase order tracking, and GST-compliant invoicing.
  - Sub-400ms P95 page load response times.
  - 100% full source code ownership in a private GitHub repository.

### 2. Intelligent AI Automations
- What it replaces: 4-hour lead response delays, manual data entry, missed follow-ups.
- Tech Stack: Python, OpenAI, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, n8n, WhatsApp Business API.
- Key Deliverables:
  - Autonomous 24/7 WhatsApp & Web chat agents answering customer inquiries and booking calendar meetings in <12 seconds.
  - Automated PDF quotation and invoice generation dispatched via email and WhatsApp.
  - Zero dropped leads with automated retry logic and dead-letter queues.

### 3. Native Android & iOS Mobile Applications
- What it replaces: Laggy web wrappers, high crash rates, offline data loss.
- Tech Stack: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Swift, SwiftUI, React Native, SQLite/Room.
- Key Deliverables:
  - Native 120Hz smooth scrolling.
  - Offline-first local database caching with instant background cloud synchronization.
  - FCM push notifications, deep linking, biometric authentication (FaceID/Fingerprint).
  - Google Play Console and Apple App Store submission and approval.

### 4. Business DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure
- What it replaces: Unmonitored server crashes, data loss, broken deployment pipelines.
- Tech Stack: Docker, Linux/Ubuntu, Nginx, Hostinger VPS, AWS, GCP, GitHub Actions.
- Key Deliverables:
  - Automated CI/CD deployment pipelines with zero-downtime rollouts.
  - Automated nightly database backups with encrypted cloud storage.
  - 99.98% production uptime SLA with PM2 process monitoring.
